Join eligible products to search queries

parameters.jsCode: const responses=$input.all(); const groups=$('Join eligible products to search queries').all(); return responses.map((item,index)=>{ const group=groups[index]?.json || {}; const response=item.json || {}; const results=Array.isArray(response.search?.results)?response.search.results:[]; const candidates=results.slice(0,50).map(row=>({product_id:String(row.product_id || ''),title:row.title || null,price:row.min_price ?? null,currency:row.currency || null,rating:row.rating ?? null,review_count:row.review_count ?? null,orders_count:row.orders_count ?? null,store_id:row.store_id || null,store_name:row.store_name || null})).filter(row=>row.product_id && row.title); const targets=Array.isArray(group.targets)?group.targets:[]; const representative=group.target || targets[0] || {}; return {json:{prompt_version:'competition-comparability-v3',group_key:group.group_key,opportunity:{opportunity_id:group.opportunity_id || null,destination_country:group.destination_country || 'FR',source_problem:group.source_problem || null,search_query:group.search_query || null,eligible_target_titles:targets.map(target=>target.target_title).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10)},target:{product_id:representative.product_id,opportunity_id:representative.opportunity_id || group.opportunity_id || null,evaluation_key:representative.evaluation_key,destination_country:representative.destination_country || group.destination_country || 'FR',title:representative.target_title,url:representative.target_url,price:representative.target_price,currency:representative.target_currency,phase3_verdict:representative.phase3_verdict,source_problem:representative.source_problem || group.source_problem},targets,search_query:group.search_query,search_run_id:response.search_run_id || null,search_status:response.status || 'error',search_warnings:response.search?.warnings || [],sample_size:candidates.length,candidates}}; });

messageValues.message: You are a conservative ecommerce market-comparability classifier. Evaluate every supplied AliExpress candidate once against the shared opportunity, source problem, and exact search query. The eligible target titles are context only; do not repeat the analysis for each target listing. Classify direct only when the candidate belongs to the same functional product family and is a realistic substitute for the same customer job. Classify adjacent when related but a different product type, accessory, refill, replacement part, or partial solution. Classify not_comparable when unrelated, keyword spam, or intended for another job. Do not require proof of every special source constraint: Phase 3 already judged individual product fit. Do not infer missing sales, quality, shipping, dimensions, specifications, brand, seller identity, or demand. Classify every supplied candidate product_id exactly once and never invent IDs. Return one JSON object only: {"prompt_version":"competition-comparability-v3","results":[{"product_id":"id","class":"direct|adjacent|not_comparable","confidence":80,"reason":"maximum 12 words"}]}. Confidence must be an integer from 50 to 100; never return 0 or null. No markdown, hidden analysis, or extra fields.

nodes.name: Write measured competition to review sheet

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all(); const payloads=$('Build comparability payloads').all(); return rows.map((item,index)=>{ const row=item.json; const key=String(row.search_run_id || index); const metadata=row.model_metadata || {}; const usage=metadata.tokenUsage || metadata.usage || metadata; const input=Number(usage.input_tokens ?? usage.prompt_tokens ?? usage.promptTokens); const output=Number(usage.output_tokens ?? usage.completion_tokens ?? usage.completionTokens); const providerTotal=Number(usage.total_tokens ?? usage.totalTokens); const actual=Number.isFinite(providerTotal) || (Number.isFinite(input)&&Number.isFinite(output)); const payload=payloads[index]?.json || {}; const estimatedInput=Math.ceil((2600+JSON.stringify(payload).length)/4); const estimatedOutput=Math.ceil(Number(row.raw_response_chars || 0)/4); const actualInput=Number.isFinite(input)?input:0; const actualOutput=Number.isFinite(output)?output:0; const total=actual?(Number.isFinite(providerTotal)?Math.max(providerTotal,actualInput+actualOutput):actualInput+actualOutput):estimatedInput+estimatedOutput; const usageStatus=row.status==='PHASE4_COMPETITION_MEASURED'?'SUCCESS':row.status==='PHASE4_RETRY'?'RETRY':'FAILED'; return {json:{run_id:$execution.id+'-competition-'+key,timestamp:new Date().toISOString(),workflow:'aliexpress_competition_analysis',prompt_version:'competition-comparability-v3',model:actual?String(usage.model || 'provider-reported-model'):'configured-in-n8n',status:usageStatus,input_tokens:actual?actualInput:estimatedInput,output_tokens:actual?actualOutput:estimatedOutput,total_tokens:total,token_source:actual?'actual':'estimated',estimated_cost_usd:null,candidates_in_call:Number(row.sample_size || 0),search_run_id:row.search_run_id,grouped_target_count:Array.isArray(payload.targets)?payload.targets.length:1}}; });

parameters.content:
## Phase 4 - grouped measured competition
- Processes only Phase 3 HOLD and SHORTLIST.
- Groups eligible products by opportunity, destination and search query.
- Opens visible Chrome once per unique opportunity/query and collects up to 50 real AliExpress results.
- Runs one AI comparability call per group, then applies the shared market measurement to every product in that group.
- Code calculates LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
- Competition means AliExpress search-sample saturation, not total global market competition.
- Writes evidence beside competition_level and logs one token record per group on port 8789.

Before running: keep ports 8787 and 8789 open, select the same Qwen credential/model used previously, and select Google Sheets credentials.
